screening_decisions.reason: Multicentre randomised controlled trial evaluating adjuvant medroxyprogesterone acetate (MPA) after surgery in stage I endometrial cancer patients. Meets inclusion criteria: RCT of progestagen therapy after endometrial cancer surgery.
This is a review article surveying literature on progestin therapy across multiple cancers, not a randomised controlled trial. Does not meet RCT criterion.
Paper on a statistical measure (I²) for meta-analyses. Not a clinical trial, not about progestagen therapy, and not an RCT. Excluded.
Book chapter on statistical methods for meta-analysis (heterogeneity, pooling). Not a clinical trial, not about progestagen therapy. Excluded.
Randomised controlled trial assigning 1148 patients with Stage I/II endometrial cancer to adjuvant progesterone after surgery. Directly addresses the review question.
Methodological paper proposing a random effects model for meta-analysis of clinical trials. Not an RCT of progestagen therapy. Excluded.

Randomised trial of progestogens in endometrial carcinoma patients who all underwent surgery; progestogen given as part of primary treatment with surgery and radiotherapy. Likely adjuvant therapy, and an RCT in women who had surgery. Include conservatively.
Methods paper on extracting summary statistics for meta-analyses with survival endpoints. Not a clinical trial. Excluded.
Randomised placebo-controlled trial of adjuvant hydroxyprogesterone after hysterectomy for stage I endometrial cancer. Meets all inclusion criteria.
Prospective randomised trial assigning 205 endometrial cancer patients to adjuvant progestagen or control after hysterectomy. RCT of adjuvant progestagen therapy, directly relevant.
